reasoning: 驗證目標：Tuner 來源下由 HU HMI 或方向盤按鍵請求 Seek Down，HU 進入 Seek Down 狀態、自下一個較低頻率起向下搜尋並停在前一個可收聽電台；波段底端則 wrap-around 回最高頻率。關鍵情境條件：FM analog tuner mode；起始頻率位於波段中段對比位於底端且其下無可收聽電台。為什麼這樣切：與 003 對稱，依 §8.3 拆輸入路徑與邊界兩個軸。刻意略過：VR Command 依 R8 委派 CFTS028。本 leaf 吸收 4872402／4872403（進入狀態與搜尋方向）——Seek Up 有獨立 leaf 004 承接同一層行為，Seek Down 在 037 中沒有對應 leaf，此不對稱本身已登記為 A-AM10 的實例。本節的訊號狀態條款（4872406/4872407/4872410/4872411）與 VES IR 條款（4872412）未通過 R10-2 判準，列為覆蓋缺口交 RD-1 Q-AM3。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 009-01 由 HU HMI 觸發並驗搜尋起點與方向、009-02 由方向盤按鍵觸發；009-03 起始頻率位於波段底端，驗證 wrap-around 回最高頻率

assumptions: [A-AM10] CFTS024-4872402 and CFTS024-4872403 (enter the Seek Down state, search from the next lower frequency, tune to the previous available station) and CFTS024-4872404 (wrap-around to the highest frequency at the band lower end) are unallocated in the 037 and elaborate this leaf; absorbed and cited. Seek Up carries the equivalent behaviour as its own leaf 004, so the two directions are not decomposed alike upstream.
[R8] The CFTS clause also grants a VR Command trigger path; out of scope for this workbook, delegated to the CFTS028 delivery.

tcs.tc_title: Seek Down from HU HMI stops on previous available station
tcs.test_item:
When the Cabin Output Channel has selected the HU Tuner source, the user can request a Seek Down to Previous Station in the current Tuner Band function (a.k.a. Skip Backward) using the HU HMI or Steering Wheel Buttons. The HU will enter the Seek Down state and go to the previous Frequency with wrap-around to the highest Frequency.

(Seek Down requested from the HU HMI)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. At least two receivable stations exist below the tuned frequency in the current wave band
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read and record the tuned frequency shown on the Radio Playing page
2. Press "Seek Down" on the Radio Playing page
3. Observe the frequency display while the search runs
4. Read the tuned frequency and listen to the audio output once the search ends
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency is displayed on the Radio Playing page
2. The seek request is accepted and the HU enters the Seek Down state
3. The first frequency searched is the next frequency step below the frequency recorded in step 1 and the frequencies shown decrease throughout the search
4. The HU is tuned to the previous available station below the recorded frequency and that station is played
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Seek Down past band lower end wraps to highest frequency
tcs.test_item:
When the Cabin Output Channel has selected the HU Tuner source, the user can request a Seek Down to Previous Station in the current Tuner Band function (a.k.a. Skip Backward) using the HU HMI or Steering Wheel Buttons. The HU will enter the Seek Down state and go to the previous Frequency with wrap-around to the highest Frequency.

(Seek Down from the lower end of the wave band — wrap-around)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. The tuned frequency is near the lower end of the current wave band and no receivable station exists between it and the lower end
5. A receivable station exists near the upper end of the current wave band
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read and record the tuned frequency shown on the Radio Playing page
2. Press "Seek Down" on the Radio Playing page
3. Observe the frequency display while the search runs
4. Read the tuned frequency and listen to the audio output once the search ends
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned frequency near the lower end of the band is displayed
2. The seek request is accepted and the HU enters the Seek Down state
3. The displayed frequency decreases to the lower end of the band and then continues from the highest frequency of the band
4. The HU is tuned to the station near the upper end of the band and that station is played
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
